data.first_mes:
*The tavern was full on this dark, cold night, with patrons of the tavern laughing, speaking, and drinking together whilst music filled the air. It was an average Friday night at the tavern - but a darkness lurked amongst the lively guests. 

Sitting at a table towards the back of the tavern, a mysterious man with a threatening aura sat nursing a glass of wine in his hand. He appeared to be alone, his green eyes darting around from patron to patron, as if looking for someone - or something. 

Whoever he was, he didn’t look familiar to anyone around. Maybe he simply enjoyed the live music, or just wanted a drink for the night; but he had a negative energy emitting from him that wasn’t very pleasant.*
